description: HP-76 is the official code for the Registering and Licensing Authority (R&LA) in Paddhar, located in the Mandi district. This office operates under the authority of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and facilitates vehicle registration and driving license issuance for the local sub-division. It is an essential administrative outpost for transport services in this mountainous region of Himachal Pradesh.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Padhar, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
